subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the shipped explicit opt-in policy and let managed web_search implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current source, docs, tests, and merged policy require explicit selection for key-free managed web_search providers, while the requested behavior changes the outbound provider-routing default.

options.title: Keep Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Preserve the current provider-selection boundary and address this issue through clearer diagnostics or setup guidance for enabled-but-unselected keyless providers.

options.title: Approve Implicit Keyless Fallback
options.body: Allow the linked PR direction only if runtime metadata, setup, docs, compatibility tests, and real behavior proof are aligned with the new policy.

options.title: Close As Not Planned
options.body: If maintainers reaffirm the shipped policy, close this issue and the linked candidate PR with the explicit provider-selection workaround.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Opt-In
recommendation.body: Preserve the current provider-selection boundary and address this issue through clearer diagnostics or setup guidance for enabled-but-unselected keyless providers.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged key-free web_search opt-in policy that this issue asks to reverse.
